footnote_text: Each performance share unit ("PSU") represented a contingent right to receive one share of the issuer's common stock upon satisfaction of the applicable performance goal and continued service through November 18, 2026.  The PSUs were granted on November 18, 2025.  On August 14, 2026, the Compensation Committee certified achievement of the applicable performance goal at 200% of target, resulting in 14,280 PSUs vesting and settling in an equivalent number of shares of the issuer's common stock on November 18, 2026.

Represents shares withheld to satisfy the reporting person's tax withholding obligations in connection with the reporting person's receipt of shares of the issuer's common stock upon the vesting of the PSUs that were granted on November 18, 2025.
